def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid_mask = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores = np.zeros_like(bins)
    valid_indices = np.where(valid_mask)[0]
    if len(valid_indices) > 0:
        valid_remaining = remaining[valid_indices]
        sorted_indices = np.argsort(-valid_remaining)
        ranks = np.empty_like(sorted_indices)
        ranks[sorted_indices] = np.arange(len(valid_indices)) + 1
        priority_scores[valid_indices] = ranks
    return priority_scores

    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if np.any(valid):
        rel_diff = np.abs(bins[valid] - item) / (bins[valid] + 1e-12)
        capacity_weight = bins[valid] / (bins[valid].max() + 1e-12)
        priority_scores[valid] = -np.exp(rel_diff) * capacity_weight
    return priority_scores
